results.name: Donnelley Financial Solutions, Inc.
results.description: Donnelley Financial Solutions Inc is a risk and compliance solutions company. The company provides regulatory filing and deal solutions via its software-as-a-service, technology-enabled services, and print and distribution solutions to public and private companies, mutual funds, and other regulated investment firms. The company operates in four segments: Capital Markets - Software Solutions, Capital Markets - Compliance and Communications Management, Investment Companies - Software Solutions and Investment Companies - Compliance and Communications Management. Its geographical segments are the United States( USA), Europe, Asia, Canada, and others, of which the USA accounts for the vast majority of its total revenue.
